scope: Root public generated declarations, their immediate members that RN's own sources declare (what the checker only reaches through String, Number, Symbol, Object.prototype or React's classes is not a contract), and explicitly declared RN globals, plus three kinds read from RN's JavaScript: the globals InitializeCore's chain installs (runtime-global), the globals RN's JS reads that the host must provide (host-global) and the commands codegenNativeCommands registers (native-command). Public values and their members carry a mechanical platformImplementation marker. Signatures retain nested types and overloads; private deep imports are outside this inventory. Rows define contracts, not behavior coverage.

runtimeGlobals.rule: Statements that install a property on the global object in the modules InitializeCore runs: the wrappers Libraries/Core/InitializeCore.js and src/setup-env.js, the entry function src/private/setup/setUpDefaultReactNativeEnvironment.js, every module that function requires as a statement (installers), and the setUp*/polyfill* modules those load. Forms: polyfillGlobal, polyfillObjectProperty, Object.defineProperty and assignment on global or globalThis, with names resolved through literals, local helper calls and Metro's __METRO_GLOBAL_PREFIX__ prefix. Each row lists its sites with the conditions around them, outermost first.

hostGlobals.rule: Names RN's JS reads as global.<name>, globalThis.<name> or global["<name>"], plus the free identifiers listed below, that no file under Libraries or src installs. A name is a row when it starts with native<Upper>, RN$ or __, or is in the allow-list; every other read must be excluded below with its reason or the generator fails. Directories named __*__ are not scanned.

platformImplementation.rule: A public value (and each of its API members) is marked when its module has a <module>.ios.js or <module>.android.js file next to it, or when the value's or member's name ends in IOS or Android. Mechanical evidence only: applicability to Godot is decided elsewhere.
